pairs: venimus in solitudinem, quæ ducit ad mare Rubrum,
we arrived at the wilderness which leads to the Red Sea,
just as the Lord had spoken to me.
et circuivimus montem Seir longo tempore.
And we encompassed Mount Seir for a long time.
And the Lord said to me:
‘You have encompassed this mountain for long enough.
Transibitis per terminos fratrum vestrorum filiorum Esau,
You shall cross through the borders of your brothers, the sons of Esau,
qui habitant in Seir, et timebunt vos.
who live at Seir, and they will fear you.
Videte ergo diligenter ne moveamini contra eos.
Therefore, take care diligently, lest you be moved against them.
Neque enim dabo vobis de terra eorum quantum potest unius pedis calcare vestigium,
For I will not give to you from their land even as much as the step that one foot can tread upon,
quia in possessionem Esau dedi montem Seir.
because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as a possession.
You shall buy food from them for money,
You shall draw water for money,
Dominus Deus tuus benedixit tibi in omni opere manuum tuarum:
The Lord your God has blessed you in every work of your hands.
dwelling with you, knows your journey,
per quadraginta annos habitans tecum Dominus Deus tuus, et nihil tibi defuit.
how you crossed through this great wilderness over forty years, and how you have been lacking in nothing.’
Cumque transissemus fratres nostros filios Esau,
And when we had passed through our brothers,
who were living at Seir by the way of the plain from Elath
venimus ad iter quod ducit in desertum Moab.
we arrived at the way which leads to the desert of Moab.
And the Lord said to me:
‘You should not fight against the Moabites,
nor should you go to battle against them.
non enim dabo tibi quidquam de terra eorum,
For I will not give to you anything from their land,
quia filiis Loth tradidi Ar in possessionem.
because I have given Ar to the sons of Lot as a possession.’
The Emim were the first of its inhabitants,
et tam excelsus ut de Enacim stirpe,
like the race of the Anakim.
They were considered to be like giants,
and they were like the sons of the Anakim. And,
indeed, the Moabites call them: the Emim.
In Seir autem prius habitaverunt Horrhæi:
The Horites also formerly lived at Seir.
When these had been driven out and destroyed,
the sons of Esau lived there,
sicut fecit Israël in terra possessionis suæ,
just as Israel did in the land of his possession,
which the Lord gave to him.
Surgentes ergo ut transiremus torrentem Zared,
Then, rising up so as to cross over the torrent Zered,
quo ambulavimus de Cadesbarne usque ad transitum torrentis Zared,
from the time that we advanced from Kadesh-barnea until we crossed over the torrent Zered,
donec consumeretur omnis generatio hominum bellatorum de castris,
until the entire generation of the men who were fit for war had been consumed out of the camp,
just as the Lord had sworn.
For his hand was against them,
so that they would pass away from the midst of the camp.
Then, after all the fighting men had fallen,
‘Today, you shall cross the borders of Moab,
et accedens in vicina filiorum Ammon,
And when you have arrived in the vicinity of the sons of Ammon,
be careful that you do not fight against them,
nor should you be moved to battle.
non enim dabo tibi de terra filiorum Ammon,
For I will not give to you from the land of the sons of Ammon,
quia filiis Loth dedi eam in possessionem.
because I have given it to the sons of Lot as a possession.’
It was reputed to be a land of giants.
et in ipsa olim habitaverunt gigantes,
And giants lived there in times past,
those whom the Ammonites call the Zamzummim.
quos delevit Dominus a facie eorum:
whom the Lord wiped away before their face.
et fecit illos habitare pro eis,
And he caused them to live there in place of them,
just as he had done for the sons of Esau,
and delivering their land to them,
which they possess even to the present time.
qui habitabant in Haserim usque Gazan,
who were living in small villages as far as Gaza,
qui egressi de Cappadocia deleverunt eos,
and they wiped them out and lived in their place.
‘Rise up and cross the torrent Arnon! Behold,
ecce tradidi in manu tua Sehon regem Hesebon Amorrhæum,
I have delivered Sihon, the king of Heshbon,
the Amorite, into your hand, and so,
begin to possess his land and to engage in battle against him.
Today I will begin to send the terror and dread of you among the peoples who are living under all of heaven,
and may tremble in the manner of a woman giving birth,
and may be gripped by anguish.’
Misi ergo nuntios de solitudine Cademoth ad Sehon regem Hesebon verbis pacificis, dicens:
Therefore, I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon, the king of Heshbon, with peaceful words, saying:
We will advance by the public way.
Sell us food for a price,
Provide us with water for money,
Tantum est ut nobis concedas transitum,
We only ask that you allow us to pass through,
sicut fecerunt filii Esau, qui habitant in Seir,
just as the sons of Esau have done, who live at Seir,
et Moabitæ, qui morantur in Ar:
and the Moabites, who abide in Ar,
until we arrive at the Jordan,
et transeamus ad terram, quam Dominus Deus noster daturus est nobis.
and we cross to the land which the Lord our God will give to us.’
Noluitque Sehon rex Hesebon dare nobis transitum:
And Sihon, the king of Heshbon, was not willing to grant passage to us.
quia induraverat Dominus Deus tuus spiritum ejus,
For the Lord your God had hardened his spirit,
et obfirmaverat cor illius, ut traderetur in manus tuas,
and had fastened his heart, so that he would be delivered into your hands,
And the Lord said to me:
I have begun to deliver Sihon and his land to you.
Egressusque est Sehon obviam nobis cum omni populo suo ad prælium in Jasa.
And Sihon went out to meet us with all his people, to battle at Jahaz.
Et tradidit eum Dominus Deus noster nobis:
And the Lord our God delivered him to us.
with his sons and all his people.
Cunctasque urbes in tempore illo cepimus,
And we seized all his cities at that time,
men as well as women and children.
which went to the share of those who plundered them.
And we seized the spoils of the cities,
quæ est super ripam torrentis Arnon,
which is above the bank of the torrent Arnon,
oppido quod in valle situm est,
a town which is situated in a valley,
or city which escaped from our hands.
omnes tradidit Dominus Deus noster nobis,
The Lord our God delivered everything to us,
except the land of the sons of Ammon,
et cunctis quæ adjacent torrenti Jeboc,
and all that is adjacent to the torrent Jabbok,
and the cities in the mountains,
universisque locis, a quibus nos prohibuit Dominus Deus noster.
and all the places which the Lord our God prohibited to us.”
